resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR, firelookout.com and Forest Lookouts date the cabin to 1935. The climbing guide quotes a 1982 history that places the replacement of the Two Point Peak lookout in the early 1930s. The story reports both and does not reconcile them.
The register gives 9,442 ft (2,878 m); firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 9,435 ft. The record's 2877.9 m matches the register.

firelookout.com/id/shellrock.html gives a 1936 L-4 cab abandoned in 1967 at 8,565 ft, 11 miles SSW of Yellow Pine. It does not match the other Shellrock sources and is probably a different site, so it is not used for the story or facts.
